assets.use: Soft radial-falloff sprite for pickup, respawn, and death burst particles.

assets.use: Hot-cored warm spark sprite for impact burst particles.
assets.parameters: size from quality profile (32/64/128); quartic core plus 1.5-power glow; deterministic, no seed

assets.use: Dark irregular-edged scorch mark stamped on surfaces at impact points.
assets.parameters: size from quality profile (32/64/128); 24 edge spokes jittered by core RNG seed 0x1a07

assets.use: Four-pointed star sprite rendered at the muzzle when a weapon fires.
assets.parameters: size from quality profile (32/64/128); crossed falloff lobes plus quintic core; deterministic, no seed

assets.use: Thin luminous ring sprite expanded along the ground by burst effects.
assets.parameters: size from quality profile (32/64/128); band radius 0.72, thickness 0.16; deterministic, no seed

assets.use: Pooled spark scatter into the hemisphere around a hit surface normal.
assets.parameters: particle count from quality profile (8/20/36); life 0.45 s; additive blending

assets.use: Pooled scorch decal stamped on the impacted surface; disabled on the low tier.
assets.parameters: life 7 s with 2 s fade; enabled by quality profile decalsEnabled

assets.use: Pooled two-vertex additive line brightening a hitscan shot path.
assets.parameters: life 0.09 s; endpoints rewritten in place per shot

assets.parameters: life 0.06 s; light gated by quality profile muzzleFlashLight
